name: Limits rest on evidence
ownerWords: i want daily duty to hunt for these and ferociously remove them aggressively
goal: No limit in auto-sns-agent's sieun/dev rests on a guess. Every cap, timeout, backoff, retry, batch or concurrency setting cites a measurement, vendor doc or incident in the ledger, or is an auth, billing or abuse bound on outside input, or it is gone with the code that served it.
onMiss: Follow limits-evidence.md next to this precheck in sieun-pi components/user-history/scripts/duties/. Read the auto-sns-agent ledger apps/llm-wiki/content/domains/devops/limits-ledger.json first and write it last. Start one subagent per app with unbacked, unjudged, returned or leftover candidates. A limit with no measurement, vendor doc or incident goes with the code that only served it. The owner chose "Remove all" for money, send and ban caps (t23), so only an auth, billing or abuse bound on outside input stays, as not_limit with that reason. Each drop is one commit, "chore(<app>): drop unbacked limit <name>", that updates every caller, test, doc, env var and config key a whole-repo search finds, and --leftovers lists nothing. Push each app's stack to a fresh ci/limits-<app>-<yymmdd>, fix red on top, and send the chat the green sha and run id for the ops train. An unbacked limit counts until its drop is on the sieun/dev tip.
